scripts.eslint: eslint --max-warnings 0 --no-warn-ignored --format stylish --color && echo ESLint: OK || (echo ESLint: FAIL && exit 1)
scripts.eslint:fix: eslint --fix && echo ESLint: OK || (echo ESLint: FAIL && exit 1)
scripts.prettier: prettier --check --log-level warn "src/**/*.{ts,tsx,js,jsx,json,md}" && echo Prettier: OK || (echo Prettier: FAIL && exit 1)
scripts.prettier:fix: prettier --write "src/**/*.{ts,tsx,js,jsx,json,md}" && echo Prettier: OK || (echo Prettier: FAIL && exit 1)
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && echo Typecheck: OK || (echo Typecheck: FAIL && exit 1)
